facts.fact: Mozambique's Ministry of Education presented its EMIS (StatEduc), updated in 2021 and 2022, as fed by censuses covering primary, secondary, adult education and school mapping.
The Ministry's Head of Statistics said Mozambique plans a fully digital platform for real-time entry, piloting tools like DHIS2 for offline dashboards.

MOZ.note: The document mentions DHIS2 only as an education pilot tool; it states nothing on Mozambique's health reporting.
